title: Box
purpose: Review one box: its facts, the grid of positions with their state and counts, the specimen IDs and storage keys of what is stored, recorded moves and history.
summary: One box: its grid of positions, the specimens stored in it, recorded moves and history.

tasks.title: See what is in a position
steps: Hover over a filled well, or select it to open the specimen record.

tasks.title: Find an available position
steps: In the key above the grid, select the [[Free]] count.
Select a position in the list to open its cell in the box grid.

tasks.title: Take a position out of use
steps: Admin and manager: select an empty position in the grid and block it with a reason.

tasks.title: Move the box
steps: Select [[Move box]], choose the rack or shelf and slot, and give a reason.

tasks.title: List the specimens in the box

good_to_know: The grid is seen from the labelled top-left corner.
A checked-out item's position counts as free. Free positions are not reserved.
An occupied position cannot be blocked. Move the item out first.
[[Retire box]] is available only when the box is empty.

sections.title: Box
paragraphs: A retired record shows a banner with when it was retired, by whom and the reason. Its Edit, Retire and Move buttons are gone.

items.label: Location
items.description: The storage unit and the racks or shelves above the box, from the top down; each code links to its page.

items.label: Box slot
items.description: The numbered slot the box occupies on its rack or shelf.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Container type name, then its code and version, with rows × columns and the labelling scheme; opens the container type.

items.label: Unit conditions
items.description: Technology and the unit's stated nominal temperature; a set point, not a measurement.

sections.title: Positions
paragraphs: The grid shows the box as seen from its labelled top-left corner: column numbers across the top, row labels down the side, one well per position with its label. A filled well is occupied, an open ring is free, and a hatched, dashed ring is blocked (the block reason appears on hover); with the specimens module, a well whose specimen has an unreleased hold is marked as on hold. The key above the grid counts occupied, free, on hold and blocked positions and the total; a count of zero is muted. The grid is created in full with the box and never changes.

Counts cover positions in active boxes; a retired box offers no free capacity. A checked-out item's position counts as free, and free positions are not reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.
Admin and manager roles can select any position that is not occupied to Block position or Unblock position while the box is active. An occupied position cannot be selected: move the item out first.

An occupied well that holds a specimen links to that specimen's record; hover shows its specimen ID and type, and screen readers hear the specimen ID after the position. Where no specimen can be shown, hover shows the storage key instead.
A positive Free count above the grid lists available positions in this box in filling order. A zero count has no link.

sections.title: Occupied positions
paragraphs: One row per occupied position, with the specimen stored there and its opaque storage key. Specimens in this box (shown while the box holds items) opens the specimen list filtered to this box.

items.label: Specimen
items.description: Specimen ID, linked to the specimen record, with its specimen type name. A dash means no specimen could be shown for that key.

items.label: Storage key
items.description: Opaque key of the item stored there, shown as its first eight characters (hover for the full key).

items.label: Revision
items.description: Version counter of the claim, used to detect concurrent changes.

sections.title: Moves
paragraphs: Recorded moves of this box, newest first, up to 20, with the number of items carried and the reason. A Correction tag marks a record that corrects an earlier move.

items.label: Correct move
items.description: Row action on the latest move, for admin and manager roles only, while that move has not been corrected. Opens the move form in correction mode; the wrong move stays in the list, and the correction is marked Correction.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin and manager roles, active box. Changes the name only.

items.label: Move box
items.description: Admin, manager and technician roles, active box. Opens the move form.

items.label: Retire box
items.description: Admin and manager roles, active box. Disabled, with the reason beside it, while the box still holds items.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The newest 50 recorded changes to this record, shown oldest to newest, each with its time, the person and the reason given. Setup entries carry no reason. History cannot be edited or deleted. With more than five entries the panel starts collapsed; select its heading to open or close it.
